assumptions.statement: No trusted official SITE_BOUNDARY or KEY_AREA polygons are available in the public site package. geometry/site_boundary.geojson (PROV-SITE-001) and geometry/key_areas.geojson (PROV-KEY-001..003) are provisional rough polygons inferred from the official announcement text (see brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries_basis.md).
assumptions.impact: All boundary-derived areas, ratios, maps, drawings, and metrics are provisional estimates for discussion only. They must be recalculated and redrawn when the organizer supplies official polygons; they are not redlines, approval bases, or precise-area bases.

assumptions.statement: Provisional areas are reported with reduced significant figures (e.g. site ≈ 11.4 km²) and are explicitly labelled as provisional estimates in every chart, metric card, HTML page, and PDF.
assumptions.impact: Readers cannot mistake rounded provisional figures for surveyed official areas. Full-precision recomputation values remain available in metrics.json for the machine gate.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation. No FAR, height, redline, demolition, or engineering conclusion is claimed.

assumptions.statement: International AI innovation ecosystem case studies are desk-research summaries from cited public sources with recorded license/reuse conditions (see sources.json and report/copyright_statement.md).
assumptions.impact: Cases are reference benchmarks and transferable mechanisms only; they are not implementation commitments, investment figures, or policy confirmations.

assumptions.statement: The AI innovation ecosystem map and the land/space/industry/capital/talent/compute/data/scenario support mechanisms are design proposals supported by cited public data and policies.
assumptions.impact: Mechanisms must be confirmed by Haidian district, universities, enterprises, and professional teams before any commitment; none are presented as approved arrangements.

assumptions.statement: The 10 AI scenario cards and 3 test/validation scenarios are concept proposals. Any real pilot requires organizer approval, site licensing, safety review, and compliance with the Generative AI Interim Measures and the Barrier-Free Environment Law.
assumptions.impact: Test scenarios are not approved operations; data minimization, human review, and privacy boundaries apply to every scenario.

assumptions.statement: AI pilgrimage landmarks, honor display systems, and cultural/signage elements are concept proposals. They must pass heritage protection review (e.g. 清华园车站旧址 protection scope), safety review, rights clearance for any third-party names/marks, and accessibility review before implementation.
assumptions.impact: Landmark and signage positions are illustrative and must not be treated as approved physical installations or heritage-protection conclusions.

assumptions.statement: The public space component library defines concept-level components with explicit safety, heritage, accessibility, and operation & maintenance boundaries (see proposal.md).
assumptions.impact: Components are design references for professional deepening, not engineering solutions or approved street furniture.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, developer community governance, scenario open-access admission, public experience operations, cooperation conversion pathways, responsible roles, and KPIs are concept operating designs for professional and organizational deepening.
assumptions.impact: Nothing in the operating design is presented as an already-confirmed government event, sponsor commitment, or implementation schedule.

assumptions.statement: Historical statements about the Jing-Zhang Railway (Zhan Tianyou, 1909 completion, first independently designed and built trunk railway in China) follow publicly documented history; cultural narrative is a design interpretation for discussion.
assumptions.impact: Professional historians and heritage authorities should verify any heritage-related claims before formal use.

assumptions.statement: Accessibility measures follow the Barrier-Free Environment Law (2023) and elderly-smart-tech plan as design guidance; final compliance design must be produced by professional teams.
assumptions.impact: This proposal does not certify compliance; it proposes design intentions for professional confirmation.
